section.title: Image offloading
section.subtitle: Images that are too old or too many stop being resent every turn
field.enabled.label: Offload images by age each turn
field.enabled.help: When on, images from earlier turns and images over budget are no longer resent every turn; when off, the images in your history stay as they are (and cost tokens).
field.userImageBudget.label: User images kept
field.userImageBudget.help: How many images you pasted across recent turns are kept at most; older ones are offloaded. Raise it if you paste a lot and do not want to lose them.
field.toolImageBudget.label: Tool result images kept
field.toolImageBudget.help: How many images from tool results (screenshots, for example) are kept at most; while computer use is running, the newest one always stays.
field.keepRounds.label: Turns of images to keep
field.keepRounds.help: Images from earlier turns are all offloaded, whatever their origin; 0 keeps only the last turn.
save.unknownKey: This section has no such setting: {key}
